description: Unit test class for the RegexPatterns class, validating various regex patterns used for entity names, feature IDs, namespaces, message subjects, and IDs within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RegexPatternsTest
classes.description: Test class for validating the regex patterns defined in RegexPatterns for various entity identifiers and message components.

methods.name: entityNameRegex
methods.description: Test method for validating entity name regex pattern against good and bad feature IDs.

methods.name: assertNameMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the given name matches the entity name regex pattern.

methods.name: assertNameNotMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the given name does not match the entity name regex pattern.

methods.name: featureRegex
methods.description: Test method for validating feature ID regex pattern.

methods.name: assertFeatureMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the feature ID matches the NO_CONTROL_CHARS_NO_SLASHES_PATTERN.

methods.name: assertFeatureNotMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the feature ID does not match the NO_CONTROL_CHARS_NO_SLASHES_PATTERN.

methods.name: namespaceRegex
methods.description: Test method for validating namespace regex pattern.

methods.name: assertNamespaceMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the namespace matches the NAMESPACE_PATTERN.

methods.name: assertNamespaceNotMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the namespace does not match the NAMESPACE_PATTERN.

methods.name: subjectRegex
methods.description: Test method for validating message subject regex pattern.

methods.name: assertSubjectMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the message subject matches the NO_CONTROL_CHARS_PATTERN.

methods.name: assertSubjectNotMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the message subject does not match the NO_CONTROL_CHARS_PATTERN.

methods.name: idRegex
methods.description: Test method for validating ID regex pattern.

methods.name: assertIdMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the ID matches the ID_PATTERN.

methods.name: assertIdNotMatches
methods.description: Asserts that the ID does not match the ID_PATTERN.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Utility method to check if a string matches a given regex pattern.
